title: NO GUN LINE ON THE PRE-RAID PAGE
why: His note of 2026-10-25 (played on an older build, still true on 34.83): the gun line on the raid prep screen does not make sense, he takes a bunch of guns into the raid, so why does it say gun = compact smg; get rid of that. The gun, gun 2 and own gun in stash chips are gone from the going up box (the pack rows still list every gun going up). The no armour warning stays exactly as it was. With armour packed the box is empty and takes no room.
now: The pre-raid page no longer says gun = something. The no armour warning still shows above ascend when you pack no armour. Watch for: no empty strip above the ascend button when you do pack armour.

edits.replacement: #sectorkit{ flex:none; margin:0 !important; padding:0 !important; border:0 !important; } #sectorkit:empty{ display:none; }   /* v28.xx (cw-nogunline): with the gun chips gone the box is empty when he packs armour, and an empty box must not leave a blank band (a 0 px item still costs the column gap) */
